# C.O.D.E. with Rust Tuesdays! 🦀 @ Blockspace Community Space

Spend your Tuesday evening writing Rust with Philadelphia’s developer community at **Blockspace Community Space**.
Whether you’re learning ownership and borrowing, building your first CLI, or already shipping Rust at work, bring your laptop, questions, and something you want to build.
**What to expect**

* Hands-on coding and time to work on your projects
* Help with Rust concepts, compiler errors, and debugging
* Conversations about systems programming and tooling
